gaps.explanation: p5 governmental funds statement (continued) prints 'Proceeds of refunding bonds' 1,545,000 (Street Fund) = statement debt_proceeds 1,545,000. detail[] already has it in full: index of the Street Fund Budgetary Comparison Schedule line 'Bond proceeds' 1,545,000 (p10). The Street Fund schedule (p10) also prints 'Bond payments' (940,000) under OTHER FINANCING SOURCES (net 605,000), recorded in detail as other-financing 'Bond payment' -940,000; that is what brings the non-transfer other-financing schedule total to 1,545,000 - 940,000 = 605,000. The statement counts the same 940,000 in Debt service Principal (p4, Street Fund 940,000), the expenditure-side gap the first pass explained. Nothing missing; the payment is printed in another section; no fix.
